d: Apple’s HomeView smart display is the centerpiece of its new push into the home. There’s plenty to like, but also some drawbacks. It’s an extension of your iPhone or iPad with access to your texts, calendar, and reminders, making it a communal device with personal content, but switching between the two is where HomeView stumbles. The $299 display brings Siri AI to a multipurpose screen designed to manage your smart home and make everyday tasks easier.
